column1: # RECOIL supports no console texture format (TIM2, PVR, GVR, 3DO, GIM and so on) and rejects every file. Evidence is the cited spec plus review by eye unless a row says otherwise.

column4: 16-bit direct color, spec sample of the TIM2 spec; RECOIL does not support TIM2. Layout per the web technology spec; render reviewed by eye (sleeping cat) and compared with i32.tm2: max channel difference 7, the 5-bit quantization
24-bit direct color, spec sample; RECOIL does not support TIM2. Layout per the spec; pixel-identical to the 32-bit i32.tm2 render
32-bit direct color, spec sample; RECOIL does not support TIM2. Layout per the spec, opaque alpha 0x80 observed on every pixel; render reviewed by eye (sleeping cat)
4-bit index with a 16-bit CLUT (CSM1, sequential), spec sample; RECOIL does not support TIM2. Render reviewed by eye (the same cat as i32.tm2, 16 colors)
4-bit index with a 24-bit CLUT, spec sample; RECOIL does not support TIM2. Render reviewed by eye (the same cat, 16 colors)
4-bit index with a 32-bit CLUT, spec sample; RECOIL does not support TIM2. Render reviewed by eye (the same cat, 16 colors); equal to i4c24.tm2
8-bit index with a 16-bit CLUT (CSM1 compound order), spec sample; RECOIL does not support TIM2. Render reviewed by eye (the same cat); scrambled colors without the bit 3/4 swap
8-bit index with a 24-bit CLUT (compound order), spec sample; RECOIL does not support TIM2. Render reviewed by eye (the same cat)
8-bit index with a 32-bit CLUT (compound order), spec sample; RECOIL does not support TIM2. Render reviewed by eye (the same cat); equal to i8c24, i8c32al and i8c32cm2
8-bit index with a 32-bit CLUT, 128-byte alignment, spec sample; RECOIL does not support TIM2. Render reviewed by eye and pixel-identical to i8c32.tm2
8-bit index with a 32-bit CLUT in CSM2 (sequential), spec sample; RECOIL does not support TIM2. Render pixel-identical to i8c32.tm2, which is stored compound

8-bit game texture (64x64, GS PSM 0 in TEX0); RECOIL does not support TIM2. Decoded as plain row-major with the CSM1 swap; render reviewed by eye (smooth grey blotches, no scrambling, a light-map style texture)

512x256 4-bit with a 320-color CLUT (20 sixteen-color palettes); RECOIL does not support TIM2. Decoded with the first palette as the spec says; reviewed by eye: striped noise, so the pixel data is probably GS-swizzled or meant for another palette. Not verified
8-bit game texture 256x256 (PSM 0x13); RECOIL does not support TIM2. Plain row-major with the CSM1 swap; render reviewed by eye (coat with trim, face patch: a coherent character texture)
24-bit game texture 256x256; RECOIL does not support TIM2. Render reviewed by eye (clothing and equipment atlas, upright)
8-bit game texture 256x768; RECOIL does not support TIM2. CSM1 swap; render reviewed by eye (metal and cloth parts atlas, coherent)
8-bit game texture 128x128 (16-bit CLUT, PSM 0x13); RECOIL does not support TIM2. Plain row-major with the CSM1 swap; render reviewed by eye (white and blue mecha parts atlas)
